ResourceHeader.ResourceName: IBEX High Energy Neutral Atom Imager (Hi) Data Release 18, Compton-Getting corrected, Survival Probability corrected, ANTIRAM Solar Ecliptic ENA Maps, Level H3, one-year average Data

RevisionEvent.Note: Initial release of metadata, ADAPT generated, LFB
Curated and checked for SPASE 2.7.2 structural and semantic consistency, OK

ResourceHeader.Description: IBEX-Hi Release 18 one-year average Solar Ecliptic hydrogen ENA maps from antiram-direction observations, collected while the spacecraft was moving away from the incoming ENAs. Compton-Getting correction has been applied to account for spacecraft motion relative to the arriving ENAs. Survival-probability correction has been applied to account for ENA losses during propagation and to scale fluxes from the IBEX observing location near 1 AU to approximately 100 AU. This is the channel-based CG/SP/ANTIRAM product, not the separate MONO product. The Release 18 annual series covers observations from 2008-12-25 through 2022-12-26, corresponding to mission years 2009-2022. The year-14 CDF records its final annual interval as 2021-12-27 through 2022-12-26 in Epoch and Epoch2. Each all-sky map has 60 longitude bins by 30 latitude bins at six-degree spacing. The channel 2-6 nominal energies are 0.71, 1.11, 1.74, 2.73, and 4.29 keV; the corresponding instrument-channel FWHM ranges are 0.52-0.95, 0.84-1.55, 1.36-2.50, 1.99-3.75, and 3.13-6.00 keV. The parameters include mapped energy, differential hydrogen ENA flux, signal-to-noise ratio, flux variance, total counts, total exposure time, and samples per pixel, with time, map, coordinate and orbit support variables. CDAWeb X/Y alternate views and Flux*_movie views are included. The CDAWeb ProductKey is IBEX_H3_ENA_HI_R18_CG_SP_ANTIRAM_1YR.
